title: XCP UDP Configuration
text: Configure XCP UDP server connection, {Error detection scheme} sets Select CTR error detection scheme One counter for all CTOs and; {Config name} sets the xCP UDP session name, {A2L File} selects an A2L file, {Enable seed/key security} selects that key required to establish, {File (*.DLL)} selects file for seed and key security file, {User-defined connect mode} allows special connect mode, {Output connection status} displays connection status, {Disable CTR error detection}, {Sample time}, {Local IP Address} sets the client IP address x.x.x.x and {Local Port} sets the client IP port 1–65535. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A2L File
params.values: Select an A2L file file name

params.name: Enable seed/key security
params.values: Select that key required to establish connection off (default) | on

params.name: File (*.DLL)
params.values: Select file for seed and key security file name

params.name: User-defined connect mode
params.values: Allow special connect mode off (default) | on

params.name: Disable CTR error detection
params.values: Disable CTR error detection scheme on (default) | off

params.name: Error detection scheme
params.values: Select CTR error detection scheme One counter for all CTOs and DTOs (default) | Separate counters for (RES,ERR,EV,SERV) and (DAQ) | Separate counters for (RES,ERR), (EV,SERV) and (DAQ)
